security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and ordinary paid-media template content. Semantic review found data-integrity risks from automatic identity matching and indirect prompt-injection exposure during web research.

remediation.issue: The workflow selects a Spotify result and discovered social profiles before patching the artist record.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation of the artist identity and each social profile before any profile update.

remediation.issue: Research and web-search content is synthesized into the workspace without an explicit untrusted-content boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Treat retrieved content as data, ignore embedded instructions, validate claims across trusted sources, and exclude executable or directive text.

content.user_title: Onboard and Enrich a New Artist
content.value_statement: Manual artist onboarding leaves roster records and workspace files incomplete. This skill creates the artist, matches Spotify data, researches profiles, and scaffolds catalog documents.
actual_capabilities: Creates a new artist record through the Recoup API and captures its account identifier.
Searches Spotify for an artist match and adds the profile image and Spotify URL.
Runs structured profile, career, playlist, and web research.
Scaffolds release documents for Spotify albums and creates a top-tracks summary.
Discovers supported social profiles and synthesizes a knowledge base in RECOUP.md.
limitations: Requires recoup-platform-api-access and authenticated access to the target organization.
Spotify search can return multiple or incorrect artists, so identity confirmation is necessary.
Public Spotify data excludes ISRCs, UPCs, credits, and detailed audience demographics.
API or research failures require recovery before the workflow can continue.

use_cases.title: Onboard a New Signing
use_cases.description: Create the roster record and gather verified Spotify, catalog, social, and background information for a newly signed artist.

use_cases.title: Standardize Roster Setup
use_cases.description: Use one resumable checklist to create consistent artist records and release folders across a growing roster.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Artist Workspace
use_cases.description: Build a practical knowledge base and catalog structure before planning campaigns or managing future releases.

prompt_templates.title: Add One Artist
prompt_templates.prompt: Add [artist name] to organization [organization ID]. Confirm the Spotify match before updating the profile, then complete the onboarding checklist.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a basic onboarding workflow with known artist and organization details.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an Onboarding
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume onboarding for [artist name] from the first unchecked item in RECOUP.md. Report completed steps and stop on any API error.
prompt_templates.scenario: Continue a workflow after interruption or a recoverable service failure.

prompt_templates.title: Build the Release Catalog
prompt_templates.prompt: Onboard [artist name], scaffold RELEASE.md for every Spotify album, and create releases/top-tracks.md. Keep unavailable fields marked as TBD.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a structured local catalog from available Spotify data.

prompt_templates.title: Run Verified Full Onboarding
prompt_templates.prompt: Onboard [artist name] for [organization ID]. Validate Spotify and social identities with me before updates, persist each step, and summarize unresolved fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Run the complete workflow with review gates and a final exception summary.

output_examples.input: Create release documents for every verified Spotify album.
output_examples.output: Created one release document per album, added the top-tracks summary, and left unavailable distributor metadata marked as TBD.

best_practices: Confirm the organization identifier and existing roster before creating an artist.
Review Spotify and social identity candidates before sending profile updates.
Persist the checklist after every successful call and stop when an API request fails.
anti_patterns: Do not run the workflow under an agent+ account because created data can become orphaned.
Do not invent artist details or add placeholder claims to profile files.
Do not continue after an API error without resolving the failed step.

faq.question: What information is required to start?
faq.answer: Provide the artist name, target organization identifier, and authenticated Recoup API access.

faq.question: Does this skill modify roster data?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates an artist record and updates verified profile information through Recoup API requests.

faq.question: How does it avoid duplicate artists?
faq.answer: The workflow expects roster confirmation before creation. Review the existing roster and organization before starting.

faq.question: Which Spotify data can it add?
faq.answer: It can use artist images, profile URLs, top tracks, albums, album tracks, durations, and explicit-content flags.

faq.question: Can an interrupted onboarding continue later?
faq.answer: Yes. RECOUP.md stores completed steps and captured values so the workflow can resume from the first unchecked item.

faq.question: What happens when an API call fails?
faq.answer: The workflow stops at the failed step. Resolve the error, then resume from the saved checklist.
